question: Can you provide a breakdown of how many times each product was viewed, how many times they were added to the shopping cart, and how many times they were left in the cart without being purchased? Also, give me the count of actual purchases for each product. Ensure that products with a page id in (1, 2, 12, 13) are filtered out.
sql:
WITH product_events AS (
    SELECT 
        e.visit_id,
        p.page_name,
        e.event_type
    FROM shopping_cart_events e
    JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy p ON e.page_id = p.page_id
    WHERE e.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13)
),
visits_with_purchase AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT visit_id
    FROM shopping_cart_events
    WHERE event_type = 3
),
product_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        pe.page_name,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN pe.event_type = 1 THEN 1 END) AS PRODUCT_VIEWS,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN pe.event_type = 2 THEN 1 END) AS ADDED_TO_CART,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN pe.event_type = 2 AND vwp.visit_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS PURCHASES
    FROM product_events pe
    LEFT JOIN visits_with_purchase vwp ON pe.visit_id = vwp.visit_id
    GROUP BY pe.page_name
)
SELECT 
    PRODUCT_VIEWS,
    ADDED_TO_CART,
    PURCHASES,
    ADDED_TO_CART - PURCHASES AS LEFT_IN_CART
FROM product_stats
ORDER BY page_name
